subject.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads

question: Should workspace discovery intentionally and silently omit hook package.json or HOOK.md files larger than 1 MiB?
rationale: The memory bound is appropriate, but the exact ceiling and silent failure mode establish a new compatibility contract that current hook documentation and tests do not otherwise define.

options.title: Accept silent omission
options.body: Treat 1 MiB as the supported workspace-hook metadata ceiling and preserve the existing silent-skip behavior.

options.title: Expose a diagnostic
options.body: Keep the 1 MiB bound but add an owner-approved warning or hook-status diagnostic when oversized metadata is skipped.

options.title: Choose another ceiling
options.body: Set a different documented limit if legitimate hook manifests or documentation may exceed 1 MiB.

recommendation.title: Accept silent omission
recommendation.body: Treat 1 MiB as the supported workspace-hook metadata ceiling and preserve the existing silent-skip behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal connects this person to workspace hook loading, boundary hardening, and the shared bounded-reader implementation.
